SKILL:
Design communication

PRACTITIONER (G7)

Typical expectations at senior grades (for example G7). Demonstrate broader influence and complexity than “working”.

Framework: https://ddat-capability-framework.service.gov.uk/skills#design-communication
SITUATION: Our team’s “apply for a licence” service had a 40% drop-off, costing £1,200 a week.
TASK: Explain the problem to the board, the policy team, and the café owners who use it.
ACTION:
I ran a show-and-tell:

• walked through 3 journeys
• played 2 clips

Then I wrote a one-page summary.
RESULT: The board said: "this is the clearest update we have had".
